zh.title: 转向祂的眷顾｜在家中一起唱诗
zh.summary: 围坐在家中的客厅，伴着吉他一起唱诗。在歌声与陪伴中，转向主的眷顾，让心安静下来。
zh.description:
在家中的聚会，不必拘谨。有人弹琴，有人唱诗，大人和孩子围坐在一起，在熟悉的旋律中，把忙碌和心事带到主面前。

一首《转向祂的眷顾》，让平常的客厅多了一份温暖。我们在歌声中彼此陪伴，学习转向主、接受祂的眷顾，也把这份安慰带回每天的生活。家中的聚会，就从这样简单的相聚开始。

en.title: The Gift of Righteousness | Singing Together at Home
en.summary: Gathered in a living room, we sing with guitar accompaniment, turn our hearts to the Lord, and find comfort in His care and one another's company.
en.description:
A gathering at home can be simple and unhurried. Someone picks up a guitar; adults and children sit together and sing. In a familiar melody, we bring the busyness of life and the concerns on our hearts before the Lord.

As we sing The Gift of Righteousness, an ordinary living room becomes a place of warmth and encouragement. We keep one another company, turn our hearts to the Lord, and receive His care. The comfort we find together can follow us into everyday life. A home gathering begins with something as simple as being together.

zh.title: 真理使我得自由（上）｜廖述涛的求学与婚姻
zh.summary: 深信科学与理性的廖述涛，在赴美求学和婚姻风浪中，如何开始接触信仰？上集从他的求学经历，讲到妻子得到帮助，以及他起初对信仰的抗拒。
zh.description:
从尊重自由、追求真理的大学生活，到赴美攻读博士，廖述涛一直相信理性与独立思考。他在德州大学看见“真理必使你得自由”的校训，深受震撼，却还不知道这句话的出处。

学业完成后，婚姻与家庭却陷入风浪。妻子在困境中接触福音，得到召会弟兄姊妹的照顾；他则对信仰和聚会抱着疑问。本集保留官方上集的见证内容，剪去书房片尾，故事接续于下集。

en.title: The Truth Set Me Free (Part 1): Liao Shutao's Studies and Marriage
en.summary: Committed to science and reason, Liao Shutao faced challenges in his studies abroad and his marriage. Part 1 follows his early life, the help his wife received, and his initial resistance to faith.
en.description:
From university life devoted to freedom and truth to doctoral studies in America, Liao Shutao trusted reason and independent thought. At the University of Texas, the inscription about truth and freedom deeply moved him, though he did not yet know its source.

After he completed his studies, his marriage entered a painful period. His wife encountered the gospel and received care from the brothers and sisters in the church, while he remained doubtful about faith and church meetings. This video preserves the testimony from the official first part, with the publisher outro removed. The story continues in Part 2.

zh.title: 真理使我得自由（下）｜廖述涛的三重顾虑
zh.summary: 信耶稣，会失去理性、自由和关爱人的心吗？廖述涛坦诚分享信主前的三重顾虑，以及他如何在耶稣关于真理与自由的话里找到回应。
zh.description:
理工背景的廖述涛，曾对信仰抱有三重顾虑：相信圣经，会不会放弃追求真理？成为基督徒，会不会背上道德重担、失去自由？爱神，会不会让自己忽略身边的人？

一次夜读见证集的经历，让他在自己熟悉的大学校训里，看见耶稣关于真理与自由的话。这条视频保留台湾福音书房官方下集的见证内容，包括三项顾虑、受浸后的挣扎，以及后来观念转变的过程。

en.title: The Truth Set Me Free (Part 2): Liao Shutao's Three Concerns
en.summary: Would believing in Jesus cost him truth, freedom, and concern for others? Liao Shutao shares his three concerns and how he found an answer in Jesus' words.
en.description:
With a background in science and engineering, Liao Shutao had three concerns about faith: Would believing the Bible mean giving up his pursuit of truth? Would becoming a Christian impose moral burdens and take away his freedom? Would loving God make him neglect the people around him?

One night, while reading a collection of testimonies, he recognized Jesus' words about truth and freedom in a familiar university motto. This video preserves the testimony from Part 2 published by Taiwan Gospel Book Room, including his three concerns, his struggle after baptism, and the change in his understanding.

zh.title: 暑期真理学校｜在日常生活中经历基督
zh.summary: 田纳西州、佐治亚州与阿拉巴马州的青少年，在暑期真理学校学习神完整的救恩与召会，也在唱诗、交通、运动和共享饭食中，一同经历基督的供应与圣徒在一起的喜乐。
zh.description:
“耶稣对他说，我就是道路、实际、生命。”（约翰福音14:6）

暑期真理学校注重真理，不只是学习道理，更是经历那位就是真理的耶稣基督。今年，来自田纳西州、佐治亚州和阿拉巴马州的初高中学生，一同学习神完整的救恩与召会，并认识如何将这些真理应用在每天的基督徒生活中。

例如，有一堂课鼓励学生，遇到难处时，转向住在他们里面的主（加拉太书2:20；哥林多后书13:5）。谈到最难忘的收获，一位学生说：“我们都有责任参与召会的建造。凡事都当为建造。”

信息和课程之间，学生们一起打排球、玩桌上足球、共享饭食。当被问到这一周最难忘的事时，一位学生简单地回答：“和圣徒们在一起。”这正是诗人在诗篇133篇所描绘的喜乐与合一，不只在聚会中，更在日常召会生活的点滴里。

en.title: Summer School of Truth: Experiencing Christ in Everyday Life
en.summary: Students from Tennessee, Georgia, and Alabama explore God's full salvation and the church, experience Christ in everyday situations, and enjoy singing, fellowship, games, and meals together.
en.description:
“Jesus said to him, I am the way and the truth and the life” (John 14:6)

Summer Schools of Truth are focused on the truth – not in the way of doctrine, but in the way of experiencing Jesus Christ, who is the truth. This year, junior high and high school students from Tennessee, Georgia, and Alabama studied God’s full salvation and the church, and how these apply to their everyday Christian life.

For example, one lesson encouraged students to turn to the Lord within them when faced with difficult situations (Gal. 2:20, 2 Cor. 13:5). Asked for a highlight, one student responded, “We all have the responsibility in building up the church. Let all things be done for building up."

Between messages and lessons, students enjoyed volleyball games, foosball, and shared meals. Asked for his highlight of the week, one student answered simply: “Being together with the saints.” It’s the same joy and oneness the psalmist describes in Psalm 133, found not just in meetings but in everyday moments with the church.

zh.title: 哦,荣耀神圣爱
zh.summary: 亚特兰大的一次聚会唱诗，众人围坐弹唱英文诗歌《O Glorious Divine Love》。

en.title: O Glorious Divine Love
en.summary: A gathering in Atlanta to sing “O Glorious Divine Love,” a hymn celebrating God’s love.

zh: 自久未创世界以先，
祢心就渴望一配偶；
彼此为居所，荣耀安排；
与我永世联属。
不知祢心所愿，我犯罪当诛灭；
而祢流宝血使我得释。
赐我祢生命，使我亲近祢；
奇妙爱！我两永世合为一。
哦，荣耀神圣爱！我如何测度，
比天空更高，比洋海更深;
冲破死权势，和撒旦国度；
无何与比拟，祢爱情于我，
如此热烈深挚，如此温柔真实;
我深深爱祢,主。
我给祢我心，我命与我魂，
无论是苦楚，或喜乐来临，
祢无限恩典，我放下所有，
建造祢召会，祢荣耀新妇。
使祢心得满足，我们互为居所，
在永世里。
en: Since long before the world began,
In Your heart You longed for a Bride;
’Tis mutual dwelling, Your glorious plan;
With me e’er to abide.
Not knowing Your heart,
I sinned and thus should die;
Yet You shed Your blood to set me free.
You gave me Your life, to me drew nigh;
Wondrous love! We two one forever will be.
O glorious divine love! How can I fathom,
Higher than the sky, deeper than the sea;
It crushes death’s pow’r and Satan’s kingdom;
Nothing can compare with Your love to me
So fervid and so deep, so gentle and so true;
I’m in love, Lord, with You.
I give You my heart, my life and my soul,
Come suffering or joy whatever betide.
By Your boundless grace, I’ll lay down my all
To build up Your church, Your glorious Bride;
Your heart to satisfy, mutual abode we’ll be
In eternity.

zh.title: 日子像钟摆，来回都是无聊？
zh.summary: 上班觉得空，放假又无聊。李光弘用一个钟摆的比喻，聊聊我们到底在为什么而活。

en.title: Is Life Just Back and Forth?
en.summary: Work feels empty. Time off gets boring. Livingstone Lee asks whether life has to swing between the two.

zh.title: 吃穿不愁，心里还缺什么？
zh.summary: 生活的需要，不只有吃饱和过好。李光弘从人的内在需要，聊到信仰带来的另一种可能。

en.title: What Are We Still Missing?
en.summary: Food, comfort and a good life matter. But what about the needs we cannot see? A conversation about our inner life and faith.

zh.summary: 李光弘从宇宙的秩序、人生的追求与《传道书》谈起，分享人在日光之下为何感到虚空，以及福音所带来的盼望。

en.title: Livingstone Lee Shares the Gospel in Atlanta | July 28, 2026
en.summary: Livingstone Lee reflects on the order of the universe, the search for meaning, and Ecclesiastes—asking why life “under the sun” can feel empty and where lasting hope is found.

zh: “天也空，地也空，人生渺茫在其中。”
“日光之下是虚空的虚空，如捕风。”
en: “Heaven and earth are empty; life is fleeting among them.”
“Vanity of vanities; all is vanity under the sun, like chasing the wind.”

zh.title: 坐进人生的头等舱，却不知道飞往哪里？
zh.summary: 家庭、学业和前途都很顺利，她却追问人生的方向。王嘉玲用“飞机头等舱”的比喻讲述自己的经历，并以主动认识造她的主，回应这个追问。

en.title: First Class in Life—But Where Is It Going?
en.summary: With a loving family, academic success and a promising future, Wang Jialing still questioned her direction. Her first-class-flight analogy leads to her response: actively seeking her Creator.

zh.summary: 一杯苦茶的比喻，连到我们拼命追求金钱、学业和关系，却仍觉得苦涩的处境；李光弘接着分享基督信仰中的盼望。
